title: Converting fixed bits to signs
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $P\subseteq[n]$, and let $z:P\to\mathbb F_2$. Assign to each coordinate in $P$ the sign corresponding to its bit under the standard bijection between $\mathbb F_2$ and $\{-1,1\}$; this defines a sign assignment on $P$.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a set of coordinates in $[n]$
